basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at HKUST NLP Group working on reasoning-capable and trustworthy language models.

work.summary: Research intern in Cupertino, mentored by Yizhe Zhang.
Worked on large-scale logical reasoning data synthesis and training for the M1 and M2.x models.
Studied perception bottlenecks in vision-language models for chart understanding.
Worked on LLM truthfulness and internal representation analysis.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

publications.name: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
publications.summary: Introduces a scalable framework for synthesizing verifiable logical reasoning data for reinforcement learning.

publications.name: On the Perception Bottleneck of VLMs for Chart Understanding
publications.summary: Analyzes vision encoder and extraction bottlenecks that limit VLMs on chart understanding tasks.

publications.name: On the Universal Truthfulness Hyperplane Inside LLMs
publications.summary: Investigates whether a universal truthfulness hyperplane exists within large language models.

publications.name: In-Context Sharpness as Alerts: An Inner Representation Perspective for Hallucination Mitigation
publications.summary: Uses in-context representation sharpness to detect hallucinations and improve constrained decoding.

publications.name: C-Eval: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models
publications.summary: Presents a multi-level, multi-discipline Chinese evaluation suite for foundation models.

publications.name: Composing Parameter-Efficient Modules with Arithmetic Operations
publications.summary: Composes parameter-efficient modules through linear arithmetic operations in weight space.
